title: "Ecological Modelling with R"

# Welcome

This repository contains the developing materials for an open educational course on ecological modelling with R.

The course introduces statistical thinking, data analysis and modelling approaches for understanding ecological processes.

# Course philosophy

> From observation to data, from data to models, from models to ecological understanding.

The main focus is not mathematical complexity, but understanding:

- how ecological questions are translated into statistical models;
- how data are explored and visualized;
- how models are built and evaluated;
- how results are interpreted.

# Learning environment

The course is developed using:

- R
- Quarto
- GitHub
- reproducible workflows

# Current status

The project is under development.
